name: Prospect of Faith
summary: In the Badlands, Prospector Ryedol sends you to Ironforge with Hammertoe's Amulet. Historian Karnik and Hammertoe sought Uldaman's lost artifacts together. Ryedol suspects the Shadowforge learned they knew more than they let on.

sections.title: A Message for Ironforge
sections.body: Prospector Ryedol sends you to Historian Karnik in Ironforge. Tell Karnik what happened to Hammertoe and place the amulet in his hands. Karnik will decide what to do next.

sections.title: Karnik's Welcome
sections.body: Historian Karnik will not hear another traveler's tale until he sees the amulet. Then he sets his mourning for Hammertoe aside and calls up Hammertoe's spirit to show you the amulet's worth.

aliases: where to start prospect of faith
faq.answer: Prospector Ryedol in the Badlands sends you to Ironforge with Hammertoe's Amulet.

aliases: why send the amulet to karnik
faq.answer: Karnik and Hammertoe sought Uldaman's lost artifacts together, so Ryedol trusts Karnik to know what to do next.

aliases: next quest after prospect of faith
faq.answer: Karnik's story continues with Passing Word of a Threat.
